description: Name Manager dialog that lists all named ranges in the workbook, allows filtering, and raises events for New / Edit / Delete.

parameters.name: Workbook
parameters.description: The workbook whose named ranges are being managed.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised when the user wants to delete the selected named range.

parameters.name: OnEdit
parameters.description: Raised when the user wants to edit the selected named range.

parameters.name: OnNew
parameters.description: Raised when the user wants to create a new named range.
